# Shell Terminal Panel

⌘⇧S: a shell in the project’s folder, in tabs beside the chat.

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The plus and the shell button answer the pointer.

## A shell where the work is

Your login shell, opened in the session’s folder, at the chat’s right. Shells are tabs: the **+** or ⌘T opens one, ⌘W closes it, ⌘K clears the screen, and a drag reorders them. They stay open until you close them or quit.

Paste a picture and it lands as the path of a file. A selection can copy itself when you let go (Settings, Terminal). Mouse-aware programs take clicks and scrolls, and the Mac’s line keys work (⌘←, ⌘→, ⌘⌫). The look is [Kaku](https://github.com/tw93/kaku)’s, in the window’s own colors and face.

The same shell opens beside the install steps on the Agents page, for the commands they give. It shares the right side with the [agent terminal](../docs/agent.llms.md): one shows at a time.
